mapper.select: SELECT io.id AS inspectionOrderId, sip.code AS planCode, io.batch_no AS batchNo, io.order_no AS orderNo, sip.material_name AS materialName, sip.material_code AS materialCode, sip.material_spec AS materialSpec, ss.name AS schemeName, ss.code AS schemeCode, ssv.version_no AS schemeVersion, io.create_by AS requestUserId, io.create_time AS requestTime, io.remark FROM lm_inspection_order io INNER JOIN lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task tpTask ON tpTask.inspection_order_id = io.id AND tpTask.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan sip ON tpTask.plan_id = sip.id AND sip.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON io.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme ss ON ssv.scheme_id = ss.id AND ss.is_deleted = 0 WHERE io.id = #{orderId} AND io.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
